import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
X = rng.normal(size=(5, 3))
y = rng.normal(size=(5, 1))
params = {
    "W1": rng.normal(size=(3, 4)) * 0.5, "b1": np.zeros((1, 4)),
    "W2": rng.normal(size=(4, 1)) * 0.5, "b2": np.zeros((1, 1)),
}

def forward(p):
    z1 = X @ p["W1"] + p["b1"]
    a1 = np.tanh(z1)
    out = a1 @ p["W2"] + p["b2"]
    return a1, out

def loss(p):
    _, out = forward(p)
    return 0.5 * np.mean((out - y) ** 2)       # L = 1/(2N) * sum (out - y)^2

def numeric_grads(p, h=1e-6):
    grads = {}
    for k in p:
        g = np.zeros_like(p[k])
        for idx in np.ndindex(p[k].shape):
            old = p[k][idx]
            p[k][idx] = old + h; lp = loss(p)
            p[k][idx] = old - h; lm = loss(p)
            p[k][idx] = old
            g[idx] = (lp - lm) / (2 * h)
        grads[k] = g
    return grads

def backward(p):
    a1, out = forward(p)
    N = X.shape[0]
    dout = (out - y) / N                        # dL/d(out)
    dW2 = a1.T @ dout
    db2 = dout.sum(axis=0, keepdims=True)
    da1 = dout @ p["W2"].T
    dz1 = da1 * (1 - a1 ** 2)                   # tanh'(z) = 1 - tanh(z)^2
    dW1 = X.T @ dz1
    db1 = dz1.sum(axis=0, keepdims=True)
    return {"W1": dW1, "b1": db1, "W2": dW2, "b2": db2}

analytic = backward(params)
numeric = numeric_grads(params)
max_err = max(np.abs(analytic[k] - numeric[k]).max() for k in params)
print("sai lệch lớn nhất:", max_err)

prompt.vi: Đạo hàm của MỘT nơ-ron sigmoid: L = (σ(w·x + b) − y)². Cài grad(w, b) trả về (dL/dw, dL/db) bằng quy tắc chuỗi: dL/dz = 2(a − y)·a(1 − a), rồi dL/dw = dL/dz·x, dL/db = dL/dz. Phải khớp đạo hàm số.
